about: The Hillstrom email test: customers randomly got a men's email, a women's email, or none. 'emailed' is 1 for either email. visit, conversion and spend are measured after the send.
review: Goals and labels drafted by Claude on 2026-11-14, paraphrases written by Claude. Not yet reviewed by Ben. The table is in local_data/, which isn't in git, so these cases only run where it has been copied over.

goals.goal: Did the email campaign get people to visit the site?
paraphrases: Did emailed customers visit more?
site visits, emailed vs not emailed
Did the email drive traffic?
did the emial get more ppl to the website

labels.why: One of the two emails against none.

paraphrases: Is spend higher for people who got the email?
spend per customer, emailed vs holdout
Did the campaign increase revenue per customer?
emailed people spend more $?

goals.goal: Did the email make more people buy?
paraphrases: Is the conversion rate higher for emailed customers?
purchase rate, email vs no email
Did the campaign lift conversions?
more ppl bought after getting the email?

goals.goal: Did the men's email get more visits than the women's email?
paraphrases: Which email drove more site visits, men's or women's?
mens vs womens email, visit rate
Was the women's version better at getting visits?
did mens emial beat womens on visits

labels.why: Visits, the two emails against each other.

goals.goal: How did the women's email do against sending nothing?
paraphrases: Women's email vs no email
Did the women's email beat the holdout?
What did the womens version achieve compared with no email?
womens email vs control, any good?

labels.why: The women's email against none; the goal doesn't say which result, so any fits.

paraphrases: Did the campaign pay off?
Should we send this email again?
was the emial campaign worth it
Is email a good use of budget?

goals.goal: What did the campaign do to sales?
paraphrases: How did the campaign affect sales?
campaign impact on sales
Did sales move because of the campaign?
sales effect of the campain

labels.why: Sales as money, using the group they confirmed.

goals.goal: Do web customers visit more than phone customers?
paraphrases: Visit rate for web vs phone customers
Are phone customers less likely to visit the site?

web vs phone ppl, who visits more

goals.goal: Do new customers buy more than returning customers?
paraphrases: Conversion for first-year customers vs older ones

newbies buy more?

goals.goal: The emails were randomly assigned. Did they raise spend?
paraphrases: It was a randomized test. Is spend higher for the emailed group?
Random assignment: did email increase spending?
randomized email test, spend lift?

goals.goal: Did sales go up after the email went out?

sales before vs after the email
Did revenue jump after we sent it?
sales after the emial went out, up?
